description: Machine-readable, evidence-bound contracts for the 15 pinned open-source agent harness reproductions.

contracts.source_contract: Pending actions execute before a new model turn; ordered tool batches stop at Finish; repeated identical failures nudge then stop; a bounded independent goal judge decides completion conservatively.
external_blockers: Full parity requires a configured model and the project-specific sandbox/tool adapters.

contracts.source_contract: Architect/editor separation, SEARCH/REPLACE parsing with partial success, at most three reflections, optional lint/test repair, explicit shell approval, and per-hunk review.
external_blockers: Exact parity with every Aider model-specific edit format is provider dependent.

contracts.source_contract: Exactly one fenced action per turn, bounded format correction, observation compaction, explicit submit/exit, checkpoints, and safe budget autosubmit.
external_blockers: Benchmark-environment parity requires the relevant SWE task image and ACI tools.

contracts.source_contract: Mode-specific visible tools, ordered permissions, concurrent approved calls, tool errors as observations, threshold compaction, and one bounded continuation.
external_blockers: IDE integration parity depends on the active editor/provider adapters.

contracts.source_contract: Reflected idea generation, conservative novelty search, isolated experiments with bounded repair, evidence-only writeup, independent review ensemble, and optional improvement/re-review.
external_blockers: Full paper-quality parity needs search APIs, LaTeX/toolchains, compute and real model reviewers.

contracts.source_contract: Seed search precedes planning; queries run concurrently; URLs are deduplicated and curated; cited synthesis abstains when evidence is absent.
external_blockers: Search/scrape quality and paywalled sources depend on external services.

contracts.source_contract: Clarification and brief are separate; a bounded supervisor delegates at most five concurrent researchers; raw evidence is compressed and final synthesis retries overflow conservatively.
external_blockers: Live parity requires configured web search, fetch and provider services.

contracts.source_contract: A persistent curriculum retrieves five skills, attempts each task four times, validates decisions with bounded correction, and stores successful executable trajectories.
external_blockers: Minecraft reset, world observation and JavaScript program execution require the MineDojo environment adapter.

contracts.source_contract: Each tick performs perceive, retrieve, plan, reflect, execute; scored persistent memories trigger evidence-linked reflection and update daily/current action state.
external_blockers: Stanford Town visibility, clock and path movement require the original simulation adapter.

contracts.source_contract: RoleZero agents receive addressed messages, a lead delegates dependency-aware tasks, reports are durably acknowledged, and company rounds/cost are bounded.
external_blockers: Exact provider/tool economics vary from the pinned upstream runtime.

contracts.source_contract: Grounded action batches retain browser evidence, interrupt after navigation, recover from repeated failures, hand CAPTCHA to a human, and independently verify completion.
external_blockers: Website behavior, CAPTCHA and authenticated sessions require a live browser environment.

contracts.source_contract: DOM/hybrid/CUA modes expose distinct protocols and caps; deterministic actions are cached and repaired; a structured final answer and fused evidence verifier are mandatory.
external_blockers: Browserbase session features and hosted CUA models remain external adapters.

contracts.source_contract: A bounded sequential tool loop records errors, supports browser context and AskHuman, and completes only through explicit typed termination; planning is a separate typed flow.
external_blockers: MCP servers, browser backend and optional Python sandbox are adapter-specific.

contracts.source_contract: A model compiles typed named-port blocks; a persisted scheduler handles static/dynamic repeated events, ready-node concurrency, review, cancellation/resume, and independent verification.
external_blockers: Hosted OAuth credentials, schedules/triggers and proprietary blocks require service adapters.

contracts.source_contract: Initial work routes through plan/status/research/code; follow-ups have distinct answer/run/deploy/feature/bug/browser/report paths; execution is safe, recoverable and checkpointed.
external_blockers: Deployment targets and third-party search/browser providers remain environment-specific.
